summary: Completed the dependent full review of Nidec Corporation's Frankfurt ordinary shares. The final independent report shows structural accounting misconduct across operating bases, including inventory valuation, impairment testing, capitalized labor, provision reversals, grant recognition and bad-debt allowances, and provisionally reduces cumulative operating profit by JPY 166.4 billion and period profit by JPY 160.7 billion through fiscal Q1 2025 before derivative effects. Preliminary fiscal-2025 sales of JPY 2.700 trillion and net debt of JPY 260 billion explicitly exclude accounting corrections and unresolved quality and customs impacts, so they cannot support normalized per-share earnings. NIB.F remains Unrated / Watch, unsupported and allocation-ineligible at EUR 14.818, with accounting uncertainty, thin Frankfurt liquidity and unsupported valuation as exact hard blockers. No linked idea exists, and no strategy, signal, order, allocation or accounting state changed.

evidence.source: Nidec final third-party accounting investigation and company response
evidence.claim: The committee found improper accounting involving inventory valuation, impairment tests, capitalized labor, provision reversals, grant recognition and bad-debt allowances across operating bases. Nidec quantified cumulative negative effects through fiscal Q1 2025 of JPY 166.4 billion on operating profit and JPY 160.7 billion on period profit, before possible additional impairment, depreciation and tax effects.

evidence.source: Nidec preliminary fiscal-2025 figures and contemplated filing extension
evidence.claim: Nidec reported preliminary sales of JPY 2.700 trillion, cash of JPY 850 billion, interest-bearing debt of JPY 1.110 trillion and net debt of JPY 260 billion at March 31, 2026. The release excludes accounting corrections and the financial effects of unresolved quality and customs investigations, preventing normalized valuation inputs.

evidence.source: Nidec interim financial statements, annual-filing extension and quality-investigation releases
evidence.claim: The unreviewed interim filing supports bounded segment and cash-flow facts but excludes accounting effects. The audited annual report remains due September 30, while the external quality investigation remains expected by the end of August with no quantified financial impact. All three retained files preserved their exact hashes at this review.
